newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Oct m/m inflation at 1.36 pct - Kolodko.
newsitem.headline: Polish Oct m/m inflation at 1.36 pct - Kolodko.

text.p: Polish consumer prices grew by 1.36 percent in October after a 1.9 percent rise in September, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said on Friday.
"In October consumer prices rose against September by 1.36 percent while producer prices grew at a slower pace," Kolodko told a news conference.
Kolodko gave no further details and official figures from the statistical office are due later on Friday.
Earlier this week Kolodko estimated October price growth at 1.2-1.3 percent, which would take the year-on-year inflation to 18.8 percent from 19.5 percent in September.
He had also predicted November inflation at 0.9 percent.
The government expects inflation to fall to 17.8 percent at the end of this year, while most analysts' predictions are in the 18-19 percent range.
